svg.title: A command deadband and a sticking valve
svg.desc: Both valves receive the same request steps of 0.5 point every 4 seconds. Valve 1 accepts a new target only after a 1-point change, so it ignores 75.5 and 76.5 percent and its stem follows the accepted target. Valve 2 holds at 75 percent while its force grows by 5 newtons per step; at 55 newtons it breaks away and slides for 7 seconds to 78.5 percent. It stays there while the request returns to 75 percent, and after a reversal to 72 percent it ends at 74 percent when the request is back at 75 percent.
svg.text: A command deadband and a sticking valve
Control Studio recording of this project · the same small request steps to both valves · numbers answer the predictions
